en: A black‑and‑white photo postcard showing a large military band posed in several rows, all wearing dark uniforms with high collars and shoulder straps. They hold a variety of instruments including trombones, trumpets, tubas, violins, cello, clarinets and drums. Handwritten Cyrillic text and numbered labels appear at the bottom of the image, identifying the ensemble and some of the musicians. The image is bordered by a white margin typical of old photographic postcards.
